name: eToys
title: Was eToys too early? No: Amazon kept selling toys
question: Was eToys too early for online toy sales?
answer: eToys went public in 1999 at a multi-billion-dollar valuation and filed for bankruptcy in 2001. Amazon sold toys online through the same years, from 2000 in partnership with Toys "R" Us. Online toy retail worked; eToys' cost structure did not.
verdict_reason: Amazon sold toys online through the same period.

constraint.name: Nothing was missing
constraint.detail: The enablers it needed already existed; something else killed it.
